summary: Karen Doyle contacted HomeNet because her internet service is frequently dropping. The agent verified her account details before transferring her to a supervisor who will review the previous calls regarding this issue. After confirming the problem with the supervisor, the call concluded when the supervisor was informed of the notes and connected Karen to their assistance.

ratings.name: Branding and Survey
ratings.reason: The agent used the correct greeting and offered a post-call survey.

ratings.name: Personalized the Call
ratings.reason: – The agent acknowledged the customer’s name ("Karen") and used “you” appropriately throughout the conversation.

ratings.name: Empathy and Acknowledgment
ratings.reason: – The agent responded to the client's frustration with understanding, validating their feelings (“I hear you”).

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: The agent maintained a calm tone, avoided interrupting, and chose words that were not aggressive. [RoBERTa flagged 1 harsh agent line(s)]

ratings.name: Paraphrasing
ratings.reason: – The agent restated the customer’s issue ("My internet keeps dropping...") to confirm understanding.

ratings.name: Verified Customer
ratings.reason: – The agent validated Karen's name and account details before transferring her.

ratings.name: Probing
ratings.reason: The agent asked clarifying questions about the problem (“It’s…”) to understand the root cause better.

ratings.name: Set Proper Expectations
ratings.reason: – The agent provided a clear next step ("They'll be with you shortly") and added notes to the supervisor.

ratings.name: Provided the Solution
ratings.reason: – The agent offered a temporary solution (briefing the supervisor).

ratings.name: Took Ownership
ratings.reason: The agent took responsibility for resolving the issue, even though it was escalated.

ratings.name: Active Listening
ratings.reason: – The agent listened attentively to Karen’s concerns without interruption.

ratings.name: Confirmed Resolution
ratings.reason: – The agent confirmed that the issue had been resolved ("They've added the notes").
